record.title: Nurse Shift Roster Optimiser with Fairness Constraints
record.description: Builds weekly nurse rosters that satisfy minimum cover, rest-period and skill-mix rules, then scores each solution on how evenly night shifts and weekend duty are shared so no one is quietly overloaded.

record.title: Loan Eligibility Rule Engine with Forward Chaining
record.description: Encodes a bank's published eligibility rules as an explicit rule base and chains through them so an applicant sees exactly which rule fired and which missing fact would change the outcome.

record.title: Bayesian Network Car Fault Diagnosis Advisor
record.description: Models the causal links between symptoms, such as a rough idle or a warning light, and underlying faults, then updates fault probabilities as the owner answers follow-up questions about the car.

record.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search Player for Othello
record.description: Implements an Othello engine that uses Monte Carlo tree search with tuned rollout policies, and measures how win rate against a minimax baseline changes with the simulation budget per move.

record.title: Automated Negotiation Agent for Bargaining Simulations
record.description: Builds software agents that negotiate over multi-issue offers with hidden preferences, comparing concession strategies and opponent-modelling tactics across thousands of simulated bargaining rounds.

record.title: Fuzzy Logic Greenhouse Irrigation Advisor
record.description: Replaces hard on-off watering thresholds with fuzzy rules over temperature, humidity and soil dryness so the advised watering duration changes smoothly instead of jumping at cut-off values.

record.title: Shipping Container Loading Planner with 3D Bin Packing
record.description: Plans how mixed-size cartons fit into a container while respecting weight balance and unloading order, comparing greedy placement with a metaheuristic and reporting volume utilisation.

record.title: Multi-Armed Bandit Recommender for Cold-Start Content
record.description: Chooses which new article or video to show when there is no click history yet, balancing exploration and exploitation with bandit algorithms and replaying logged traffic to estimate regret offline.

record.title: Household Task Planner Using PDDL
record.description: Describes a home environment and chores in PDDL and uses an automated planner to sequence actions such as fetching, washing and storing, then explains why a goal is unreachable when constraints conflict.

record.title: Counterfactual Explanation Generator for Tabular Models
record.description: Given a rejected prediction, searches for the smallest realistic change to the inputs that would flip the decision, constraining edits to features a person could actually alter.

record.title: Active Learning Annotation Assistant
record.description: Reduces labelling effort by repeatedly asking a human to label only the examples a model is most uncertain about, and plots accuracy against labels spent for several query strategies.

record.title: Case-Based Reasoning Helpdesk Assistant
record.description: Retrieves the most similar solved support cases for a new IT problem, adapts the earlier fix to the new context and stores confirmed outcomes so the case library improves over time.

record.title: Knowledge Tracing for Programming Exercises
record.description: Estimates what a student has mastered from their sequence of exercise attempts and recommends the next problem, comparing Bayesian knowledge tracing with a sequence model on held-out students.

record.title: Chord Progression Harmoniser from a Melody
record.description: Suggests chords for a short melody using music-theory rules about key, cadences and voice leading, and lets the user compare rule-based output with a simple probabilistic model.

record.title: Equilibrium Strategy for Kuhn Poker with Counterfactual Regret Minimisation
record.description: Solves a small poker variant with counterfactual regret minimisation, shows the strategy converging towards equilibrium, and tests it against exploitative opponents.

record.title: Agent-Based Evacuation Simulation of a Campus Building
record.description: Simulates how people leave a building during an alarm, with crowd congestion at doors and stairwells, and tests how exit signage or an extra door changes total evacuation time.

record.title: Prerequisite Graph Analyser for Degree Programmes
record.description: Reads a course catalogue into a directed graph, detects circular prerequisites, finds the longest dependency chain and highlights courses that block the most downstream options.

record.title: Sokoban Solver with Deadlock Detection
record.description: Solves box-pushing puzzles with heuristic search, adds deadlock detection to prune hopeless states early, and reports how much pruning reduces the number of states explored.

record.title: Two-by-Two Cube Solver with IDA-star
record.description: Solves the pocket cube optimally using iterative-deepening A-star with a pattern-database heuristic, and compares memory use and solve time with plain breadth-first search.

record.title: Argumentation Framework Solver for Debate Maps
record.description: Represents arguments and the attacks between them as a graph and computes which sets of arguments can be defended together under several formal semantics, visualising the result.

record.title: Ambulance Station Placement with Facility Location Optimisation
record.description: Chooses where to place a limited number of ambulance stations so that the worst-case response time across a city grid is as low as possible, comparing exact and heuristic solvers.

record.title: Text Adventure Engine with Finite State Dialogue
record.description: Builds a small adventure game where rooms, items and non-player dialogue are defined in data files and driven by a finite state machine, so a new story needs no code changes.

record.title: Hangman Solver Using Letter Frequencies and Language Models
record.description: Plays hangman by choosing the most informative next letter from a word list, then compares plain frequency counting with a model that conditions on the letters already revealed.

record.title: Interactive Decision Tree Teaching Tool
record.description: Lets learners build a decision tree one split at a time on a small dataset, shows entropy and information gain at every choice, and compares their tree with the algorithm's.

record.title: Q-Learning Controller for a Multi-Lift Building
record.description: Trains lift controllers with reinforcement learning to reduce average passenger waiting time in a simulated building, and compares the learned policy with a nearest-car rule under rush-hour traffic.

record.title: Self-Play Agent for Dots and Boxes
record.description: Trains an agent to play dots and boxes through self-play and shows how its handling of chains and sacrifices improves compared with a greedy opponent.

record.title: Event Seating Planner with Social Constraints
record.description: Assigns guests to tables so that listed pairs sit together and conflicting pairs are kept apart, using a constraint solver and showing which wishes had to be compromised.

record.title: Genetic Algorithm Exam Invigilation Duty Allocator
record.description: Allocates invigilation duties to staff across exam sessions while respecting availability, workload caps and room rules, evolving schedules with a genetic algorithm and reporting constraint violations.

record.title: Subscriber Survival Analysis for Time-to-Cancellation
record.description: Models how long subscribers stay rather than only whether they leave, using Kaplan-Meier curves and a Cox model, and shows which plan features lengthen or shorten the expected lifetime.

record.title: Uplift Modelling for Discount Targeting
record.description: Estimates which customers are actually persuaded by a discount, rather than those who would buy anyway, by modelling the difference in outcome between treated and untreated groups.

record.title: Propensity Score Matching for Evaluating a Tutoring Programme
record.description: Estimates the effect of an optional tutoring scheme on exam results from observational records by matching similar students and checking covariate balance before and after matching.

record.title: Probability Calibration Toolkit for Classifiers
record.description: Checks whether predicted probabilities can be trusted by drawing reliability curves, then fixes miscalibrated models with Platt scaling and isotonic regression and reports the change in Brier score.

record.title: Imbalanced Learning Benchmark on Rare-Event Datasets
record.description: Compares resampling, class weighting and threshold moving on datasets where the positive class is under one percent, and reports precision-recall behaviour rather than accuracy.

record.title: Learning to Rank Search Results from Click Logs
record.description: Trains a ranking model from simulated click data, corrects for position bias in the clicks, and evaluates the ordering with normalised discounted cumulative gain.

record.title: Bus Arrival Time Prediction from Historical GPS Traces
record.description: Predicts when a bus will reach each remaining stop using past trips, time of day and the delay already accumulated on the current route, and reports error by distance to the stop.

record.title: Perishable Stock Spoilage Predictor for Grocers
record.description: Predicts how many units of fresh produce will spoil before sale from delivery date, storage temperature and sales rate, so ordering can be trimmed without causing stock-outs.

record.title: Conformal Prediction Intervals for Delivery Time Estimates
record.description: Wraps any regression model with conformal prediction so each delivery estimate comes with an interval that provably covers the true time at a chosen rate, and checks coverage by customer segment.

record.title: Model Drift Monitor for a Deployed Classifier
record.description: Detects when live input data no longer resembles training data using population stability and statistical tests, and raises an alert before accuracy visibly degrades.

record.title: Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimisation Workbench
record.description: Compares random search, grid search and Bayesian optimisation on the same models and budgets, and plots how quickly each finds good settings.

record.title: Quantile Regression for Energy Price Risk Bands
record.description: Predicts the range a day-ahead electricity price is likely to fall in rather than one number, using quantile regression and evaluating the bands with pinball loss.

record.title: Mobility Pattern Clustering from Anonymised Trip Records
record.description: Groups commuters by when and where they travel using clustering on trip features, and describes each group in terms a transport planner can act on.

record.title: Multi-Label Tagging of Support Articles
record.description: Assigns several topic tags to each help-centre article at once with a multi-label classifier, and shows per-tag precision so weak tags can be reviewed by a person.

record.title: Semi-Supervised Image Feature Classifier with Few Labels
record.description: Trains a classifier when only a tenth of the data is labelled by propagating labels through feature similarity, and charts accuracy against the number of true labels used.

record.title: Spare Part Demand Forecasting with Intermittent Series
record.description: Forecasts demand for parts that sell in sporadic bursts using methods built for intermittent data, and shows why ordinary error metrics mislead on such series.

record.title: Feature Store Prototype for Reusable Model Inputs
record.description: Builds a small feature store that computes features once, serves them consistently to training and prediction code, and prevents leakage from future data with point-in-time joins.

record.title: Interpretable Credit Limit Scorecard with Monotonic Constraints
record.description: Builds a scorecard where each variable moves the score in a sensible direction, using monotonic constraints and weight of evidence, and documents every reason code.

record.title: Course Grade Prediction with Prerequisite Performance
record.description: Predicts a student's grade in a course from their results in prerequisite courses, and shows which earlier subjects are the strongest predictors.

record.title: Matching Engine for Peer Study Groups
record.description: Forms study groups by clustering students on course load, availability windows and learning preferences, and checks that groups are balanced in size and schedule overlap.

record.title: Online Learning Fraud Detector for Streaming Transactions
record.description: Updates a fraud model one transaction at a time without retraining from scratch, and compares its adaptation to changing fraud patterns with a periodically retrained batch model.

record.title: Patient No-Show Predictor for Clinic Scheduling
record.description: Estimates which appointments are likely to be missed so a clinic can plan overbooking and reminder calls, and audits the model for unequal error rates across age groups.

record.title: Ensemble Stacking Playground for Tabular Data
record.description: Lets a learner combine several base models through stacking and blending, and measures when the combination beats the best single model and when it only adds complexity.

record.title: Outlier Detection Comparison on Sensor Readings
record.description: Applies several outlier detectors to the same sensor dataset with known injected faults and compares how many faults each finds and how many normal readings it wrongly flags.

record.title: Learning Curve Explorer for Model Selection
record.description: Plots training and validation scores against dataset size and model complexity so a beginner can see whether a model needs more data, more capacity or less of both.

record.title: Cricket Run-Rate Projection from Ball-by-Ball Data
record.description: Projects the final score of an innings from the match state so far, accounting for wickets in hand and overs left, and measures how projection error shrinks as the innings progresses.

record.title: Knowledge Distillation into a Mobile-Sized Image Classifier
record.description: Trains a small student network to imitate a large teacher by matching softened outputs, and reports accuracy, model size and inference time for students with and without distillation.

record.title: Contrastive Learning of Image Embeddings without Labels
record.description: Learns useful image representations from unlabelled pictures using contrastive loss on augmented views, then tests them with a linear classifier trained on very few labels.

record.title: Variational Autoencoder for Exploring a Font Latent Space
record.description: Trains a variational autoencoder on font glyphs and lets users move through the latent space to blend styles, while checking how smooth and meaningful the interpolations are.

record.title: GAN for Synthetic Tabular Data with Privacy Evaluation
record.description: Generates synthetic customer-style records with a conditional GAN and evaluates both how useful they are for training and how easily real rows can be re-identified from them.

record.title: Prototypical Networks for Few-Shot Image Classification
record.description: Classifies new categories from five examples each by comparing images with learned class prototypes, and studies how accuracy changes with the number of shots and ways.

record.title: Transformer Encoder for Multivariate Sensor Forecasting
record.description: Forecasts several correlated sensor channels with a transformer encoder and compares it with LSTM and linear baselines, including how each handles long input windows.

record.title: Keyword Spotting for Tiny Devices
record.description: Trains a compact network to recognise a handful of spoken commands from audio spectrograms and measures how small it can be made before accuracy on noisy clips falls.

record.title: Neural Network from Scratch with a Backpropagation Visualiser
record.description: Implements a small feed-forward network using only NumPy and animates how gradients flow backwards through each layer on a toy problem, so each update can be traced by hand.

record.title: Optimiser and Learning Rate Schedule Comparison Lab
record.description: Trains the same small network with different optimisers and learning rate schedules and plots loss curves side by side, so the effect of each choice is visible rather than assumed.

record.title: Adversarial Robustness Testing for Image Classifiers
record.description: Crafts small perturbations that fool a trained classifier, measures how accuracy falls with perturbation size, and tests whether adversarial training restores robustness.

record.title: Grad-CAM Explanations for CNN Predictions
record.description: Highlights the image regions a convolutional network relied on for a prediction using Grad-CAM, and checks whether the highlights move when the model is trained on a biased dataset.

record.title: Siamese Network for Few-Shot Character Recognition
record.description: Learns whether two handwritten characters belong to the same alphabet symbol and uses that similarity to recognise symbols seen only once during training.

record.title: Sequence-to-Sequence Date and Number Format Normaliser
record.description: Trains a small encoder-decoder to convert dates and numbers written in many human formats into one standard form, and inspects which input styles it still gets wrong.

record.title: Graph Neural Network for Citation Network Classification
record.description: Classifies research papers into topics using both their text features and the citation links between them, and compares a graph network with a model that ignores the links.

record.title: Autoencoder Recommender for Sparse Rating Matrices
record.description: Predicts missing ratings by training an autoencoder on partially observed user histories, and compares it with matrix factorisation on held-out entries.

record.title: Beat and Tempo Tracking from Audio with a Small CNN
record.description: Detects beat positions in music from spectrogram features using a convolutional network, then estimates tempo and checks it against annotated tracks.

record.title: Mixed-Precision and Gradient Accumulation Study for Small GPUs
record.description: Measures how mixed-precision training and gradient accumulation change memory use, speed and final accuracy so a student with a modest GPU can train larger models.

record.title: Deep Q-Network Agent for Lunar Landing
record.description: Trains a deep Q-network to land a simulated craft, adding experience replay and a target network, and shows the effect of each ingredient on learning stability.

record.title: Small Diffusion Model for Handwritten Digit Generation
record.description: Builds a denoising diffusion model on a small image set, visualises the reverse denoising steps and compares sample quality as the number of sampling steps is reduced.

record.title: Pretrained Backbone Transfer Learning Benchmark
record.description: Fine-tunes several pretrained image backbones on the same small dataset under one training budget and compares accuracy, training time and sensitivity to learning rate.

record.title: LSTM versus GRU Temperature Forecast Comparison
record.description: Forecasts next-day temperature from recent history with LSTM and GRU models of matching size and compares accuracy, training speed and behaviour on unusual weeks.

record.title: Bird Call Classification from Spectrogram Images
record.description: Identifies bird species from short field recordings by converting audio to spectrograms and training a CNN, with attention to background noise and overlapping calls.

record.title: Learned Image Compression with an Autoencoder
record.description: Compresses images with a convolutional autoencoder trained against a rate and distortion trade-off, and compares quality at equal file size with JPEG.

record.title: Data Augmentation Policy Study for Small Datasets
record.description: Tests which augmentations help a small-image classifier and which hurt, by training with each one alone and in combination and reporting the accuracy change with its variance.

record.title: Model Quantisation and Pruning Impact Study
record.description: Applies post-training quantisation and weight pruning to a trained network and charts the trade-off between size, latency and accuracy on a target device.

record.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Heat Equation
record.description: Solves a one-dimensional heat conduction problem with a network trained to satisfy the differential equation and boundary conditions, and compares the result with a numerical solver.

record.title: Code-Mixed Hinglish Sentiment Classifier
record.description: Classifies sentiment in messages that mix Hindi written in Roman letters with English, handling inconsistent spellings and comparing a character-level model with a word-level one.

record.title: Contract Deadline and Renewal Date Extractor
record.description: Finds notice periods, renewal dates and payment deadlines in contract text, normalises relative expressions such as thirty days after signing, and lists them in a calendar view.

record.title: Commit Message Generator from Code Diffs
record.description: Generates short imperative commit messages from a code diff with a sequence model, and evaluates them against real commit messages using overlap metrics and a manual quality check.

record.title: Duplicate Question Detector for a Programming Forum
record.description: Flags new questions that repeat an existing one by comparing meaning rather than wording, and measures how many true duplicates surface in the top five suggestions.

record.title: Lecture Transcript Glossary Builder
record.description: Pulls out the technical terms a lecturer defines in a transcript and assembles a glossary with a definition sentence and first-mention timestamp for each term.

record.title: Clickbait Headline Detector
record.description: Trains a classifier to separate clickbait from informative headlines and shows which words and patterns push a headline towards each label.

record.title: Review Helpfulness Predictor
record.description: Predicts how useful a product review will be to other shoppers from its text, length and detail, and checks whether the model simply rewards long reviews.

record.title: Poetry Meter and Rhyme Scheme Analyser
record.description: Scans English verse for syllable stress patterns and end rhymes using a pronunciation dictionary, then labels the metre and rhyme scheme of each stanza.

record.title: Phonetic Name Matching for Record Linkage
record.description: Links records whose names are spelled differently but sound alike, by combining phonetic encodings with edit distance, and reports precision and recall on a labelled sample.

record.title: Transliteration of Indian Language Names into English
record.description: Converts personal names from Devanagari script into Roman letters with a character-level sequence model and measures exact-match accuracy against several accepted spellings.

record.title: Dialogue State Tracker for a Restaurant Booking Bot
record.description: Tracks what a customer has asked for across turns, such as cuisine, party size and time, and updates or retracts slots as the user changes their mind.

record.title: Emoji Suggestion for Short Messages
record.description: Suggests an emoji that fits the tone of a short message by training a classifier on messages that already contain emoji, and discusses why many answers are equally valid.

record.title: Job Posting Scam Detector
record.description: Identifies fraudulent job advertisements from wording, missing company details and payment requests, and reports which signals drive each decision so users can learn the warning signs.

record.title: Entity Linking to a Reference Knowledge Base
record.description: Maps mentions such as Apple or Mercury in text to the correct entry in a small knowledge base using context, and evaluates disambiguation accuracy on ambiguous mentions.

record.title: Answer Attribution Checker for Retrieval-Based QA
record.description: Verifies that each sentence in a generated answer is actually supported by one of the retrieved passages, highlights unsupported claims and scores overall faithfulness.

record.title: Formal and Informal Style Transfer
record.description: Rewrites informal messages in a formal register and back while preserving meaning, and evaluates style accuracy and content preservation separately.

record.title: Acronym Disambiguation in Technical Documents
record.description: Decides what an ambiguous acronym such as CPU, PCA or SDK stands for in a given paragraph, using the surrounding words and a dictionary of expansions found elsewhere in the document.

record.title: Song Lyrics Mood Classifier
record.description: Labels song lyrics as happy, sad, angry or calm with a text classifier, and examines where lyrics disagree with the mood a listener would assign.

record.title: Math Word Problem Solver for Primary Arithmetic
record.description: Converts short arithmetic word problems into equations and solves them, showing the extracted quantities so a teacher can see where the interpretation went wrong.

record.title: Claim Matching Against a Fact-Check Archive
record.description: Retrieves previously fact-checked claims that match a new social media statement, even when the wording differs, and presents the original verdict with its source.

record.title: Punctuation and Casing Restoration for Speech Transcripts
record.description: Adds commas, full stops and capital letters to raw transcripts with a token classification model, and reports per-mark precision and recall.

record.title: Keyword-in-Context Concordancer for Language Learners
record.description: Lets learners search a text collection for a word and see it in context with the words that commonly appear beside it, sorted by frequency and part of speech.

record.title: Sentence Embedding Model Comparison on Domain Similarity
record.description: Compares several sentence embedding models on a hand-built similarity set from one domain, such as cooking or law, and reports which model ranks related sentences best.

record.title: Gender Bias Audit of Word Embeddings for Occupations
record.description: Measures how strongly pretrained word vectors associate occupations with gendered words, and tests whether a simple debiasing step reduces the association without harming analogy accuracy.

record.title: English Dialect Classifier from Written Text
record.description: Distinguishes regional varieties of English such as British, American and Indian from spelling and vocabulary, and lists the features that carry the most weight for each variety.

record.title: Question Intent Router for a University Helpdesk
record.description: Routes student questions to the right department with a small intent classifier, and shows a confidence score so low-confidence questions go to a human instead.

record.title: Receipt Parser for Totals and Line Items from Photos
record.description: Reads photographed shop receipts, straightens and cleans the image, then extracts store, date, line items and total, flagging results where the items do not add up to the printed total.

record.title: Chart Image to Data Table Extraction
record.description: Recovers approximate numeric values from bar and line chart images by detecting axes, ticks and marks, and reports how close the reconstructed table is to the original data.

record.title: Leaf Area Measurement from Phone Photos
record.description: Estimates the area of leaves photographed on a sheet with a reference square by thresholding and counting pixels, then tracks growth over several days.

record.title: Dominant Colour Palette Extractor for Designers
record.description: Extracts a small, visually distinct colour palette from an image using clustering, and exports it with hex codes and contrast ratios for accessible text choices.

record.title: Traffic Sign Recognition with a Compact CNN
record.description: Classifies road signs from cropped images with a compact convolutional network and tests how accuracy drops under blur, glare and partial occlusion.

record.title: Keyframe-Based Video Summariser
record.description: Condenses a long video into a handful of representative frames by detecting scene changes and removing near-identical shots, and builds a contact-sheet summary.

record.title: Motion Detection Camera with Region Masks
record.description: Records clips only when movement occurs inside user-drawn regions of a camera view, ignoring trees swaying or screens flickering in masked-out areas.

record.title: Badminton Court Line Detection and Shot Placement Map
record.description: Detects the court lines in match video, maps shuttle landing points into court coordinates with a homography, and charts where each player's shots land.

record.title: Seed Counting and Size Distribution from Images
record.description: Counts seeds spread on a tray and measures their sizes using watershed splitting for touching seeds, producing a size histogram a grower can use for grading.

record.title: Tree Canopy Segmentation from Drone Images
record.description: Segments tree canopy from orthomosaic drone tiles and estimates canopy cover per plot, comparing a classical vegetation index approach with a trained segmentation network.

record.title: Solder Joint Inspection on Circuit Boards
record.description: Classifies solder joints on board photographs as acceptable, bridged or missing, locating each joint first and explaining the decision with highlighted regions.

record.title: Near-Duplicate Photo Finder for Large Libraries
record.description: Finds photos that are near copies, such as resized or recompressed versions, with perceptual hashing and groups them so a user can keep the best of each cluster.

record.title: Sudoku Grid Reader from a Photograph
record.description: Locates a printed sudoku puzzle in a photo, corrects the perspective, recognises each digit and passes the grid to a solver, reporting cells it could not read confidently.

record.title: Whiteboard Capture with Rectification and Enhancement
record.description: Turns a slanted photo of a whiteboard into a clean, evenly lit page by finding its corners, flattening it and removing shadows, ready to share as a PDF.

record.title: Analogue Gauge and Meter Reader
record.description: Reads the value shown on a dial gauge from a photo by locating the needle and the scale marks, and converts the angle into a reading with an estimate of the error.

record.title: Camera Calibration and Lens Distortion Correction Tool
record.description: Calibrates a camera from chessboard photographs, computes its intrinsic parameters and straightens distorted images, reporting the reprojection error for each calibration photo.

record.title: Vehicle Speed Estimation with Optical Flow
record.description: Estimates the speed of vehicles in roadside video by tracking motion and converting pixel displacement to metres using a measured reference distance, validated against known speeds.

record.title: Building Footprint Extraction from Aerial Tiles
record.description: Outlines buildings on aerial image tiles with a segmentation model and converts masks into clean polygons that can be loaded into a map layer.

record.title: Face Blurring Privacy Filter for Videos
record.description: Detects faces in a video and blurs them frame by frame, keeping the blur steady when a detection briefly drops out between frames.

record.title: Printed Sheet Music Symbol Recognition
record.description: Detects staff lines and recognises note heads, rests and clefs in a scanned score, then produces a playable representation of a single melody line.

record.title: Chess Position Recognition from a Board Photo
record.description: Reads the pieces on a physical chessboard from a photograph, converts the position to standard notation and checks that the result is a legal position.

record.title: Posture Monitor for Desk Workers via Webcam
record.description: Estimates head and shoulder angles from a webcam and nudges the user when they slump for too long, with all video processed locally and never stored.

record.title: Fabric Pattern Defect Detection
record.description: Detects flaws such as snags and misprinted patterns in textile images by learning what normal fabric looks like and flagging regions that differ.

record.title: Coin Counter from a Tabletop Photo
record.description: Finds round coins in a photo, classifies them by size and then totals their value, using a reference coin for scale and reporting overlapping coins it cannot separate.

record.title: Colony Counting on Petri Dish Images
record.description: Counts bacterial colonies on culture plate photographs, splits touching colonies and reports counts with an uncertainty estimate for use in teaching laboratories.

record.title: Handwriting Slant and Spacing Analyser for Penmanship Practice
record.description: Measures slant, letter spacing and baseline consistency in a photo of handwriting and gives practice feedback, without trying to read the text itself.

record.title: Bus Route Overcrowding Analysis from Ticketing Data
record.description: Uses boarding records to find which routes and time bands exceed seat capacity, and quantifies how much extra service would be needed to bring them under a target load.

record.title: Fuel Price Pass-Through Analysis
record.description: Estimates how quickly and fully changes in crude oil prices reach pump prices using lagged regression, and tests whether prices rise faster than they fall.

record.title: School Dropout Funnel Analysis by Region
record.description: Tracks cohorts of students from enrolment to completion across regions, locates where in the school system the largest losses occur and charts the gaps between regions.

record.title: Retail Basket Co-Purchase Network Explorer
record.description: Builds a network of products that are bought together, detects communities of related items and lets a merchandiser explore which groups should sit on the same shelf.

record.title: Simpson's Paradox Teaching Dashboard
record.description: Demonstrates how an overall trend can reverse inside every subgroup using real tables, letting learners toggle groupings to see the reversal appear and disappear.

record.title: Survey Weighting and Margin of Error Calculator
record.description: Applies post-stratification weights to a skewed survey sample and reports how weighting changes estimates and their margins of error, with the method explained step by step.

record.title: Public Library Usage Trends Dashboard
record.description: Summarises borrowing, visits and programme attendance across branches and years, highlighting seasonal patterns and branches whose use is declining.

record.title: Bike Lane Safety Analysis from Crash Records
record.description: Combines crash records with infrastructure data to compare injury rates on streets with and without protected lanes, adjusting for traffic volume before drawing any conclusion.

record.title: Wage Gap Decomposition Study
record.description: Splits an observed pay difference between groups into the part explained by job, experience and education and the unexplained remainder, and discusses what the method can and cannot show.

record.title: Water Quality Compliance Tracker
record.description: Compares periodic water sample results with legal limits, flags exceedances by location and parameter, and charts how long each site has been compliant.

record.title: Sleep and Study Habit Survey Analysis
record.description: Analyses a class survey on sleep and study time with correlation, grouped comparisons and clear charts, and practises stating limitations honestly.

record.title: Electricity Bill Anomaly Finder for Households
record.description: Flags months when a household bill deviates from its own seasonal pattern and suggests probable reasons from weather and appliance changes recorded by the user.

record.title: Housing Rent Gradient Around Transit Stations
record.description: Measures how rents change with distance to rail stations using hedonic regression and spatial controls, and maps where the premium is largest.

record.title: Exam Question Difficulty and Discrimination Analysis
record.description: Computes item difficulty and discrimination indices from exam results and flags questions that are too easy, too hard or that top students answer worse than weaker ones.

record.title: Bootstrap Confidence Interval Explorer
record.description: Lets users resample a small dataset to see how the sampling distribution of a statistic emerges, and compares bootstrap intervals with textbook formulas.

record.title: Mobile Plan Cost Optimiser from Usage History
record.description: Recommends the cheapest mobile plan for a user's own call, data and message history by costing every plan against past months, including overage charges.

record.title: Event Attendance Forecasting for Campus Fests
record.description: Predicts attendance for campus events from past editions, weekday, weather and promotion channels, and reports forecast error separately for large and small events.

record.title: Agricultural Commodity Price Seasonality Study
record.description: Decomposes market price series for crops into trend, seasonal and irregular parts and identifies the months when farmers historically received the best and worst prices.

record.title: Open Government Contract Spending Explorer
record.description: Cleans public procurement records, groups spending by supplier and category and highlights concentration, such as a few suppliers receiving most of a department's budget.

record.title: Weather Station Data Quality Checker
record.description: Screens weather station records for impossible values, stuck sensors and gaps, and produces a quality report with the share of readings usable for analysis.

record.title: Customer Complaint Resolution Time Analysis
record.description: Analyses time to resolve complaints by category and team, identifies slow stages in the process and tests whether a new triage rule changed resolution times.

record.title: Digital Payment Adoption Study Across Districts
record.description: Maps the spread of digital payment usage across districts over several years and relates it to infrastructure and literacy indicators, with attention to correlation limits.

record.title: Lifetime Fitness Activity Trend Analyser

record.description: Demonstrates switching an application to new database credentials with zero failed requests, using dual-credential periods and health checks at each stage.

record.title: Container Image Build Reproducibility Checker
record.description: Builds the same image twice, compares the results layer by layer and tracks down sources of non-determinism such as timestamps and unpinned packages.

record.title: Capacity Planning Model from Load Test Results
record.description: Fits a simple model to load test results to estimate when a service will saturate, and recommends how many instances are needed for a forecast traffic peak.

record.title: Feature Branch Environment Cost Tracker
record.description: Tracks how long temporary environments stay running per branch, estimates their cost and nudges owners to shut down ones that have been idle.

record.title: Service Dependency Map from Network Flows
record.description: Builds a map of which services talk to which from flow records, highlights unexpected connections and shows the blast radius if one service fails.

record.title: Runbook Automation Engine
record.description: Turns written operational runbooks into executable steps with approvals, dry-run mode and a log of what ran, so routine incident actions are consistent and reviewable.

record.title: Incident Timeline Builder from Alerts and Chat
record.description: Merges alerts, deploys and chat messages into one timeline of an outage and drafts a post-incident review with the key events and durations filled in.

record.title: Dependency Update Bot with Safe Merge Rules
record.description: Opens pull requests for outdated dependencies, groups related updates, runs tests and merges only those that meet defined risk rules, with a record of every decision.

record.title: Multi-Environment Helm Chart with Policy Checks
record.description: Packages an application as a parameterised chart for several environments and validates each rendered result against policy rules before it can be deployed.

record.title: Edge Cache Hit Ratio Analyser
record.description: Analyses CDN logs to find which content is rarely cached, explains likely reasons such as cache-busting query strings and estimates the bandwidth saved by fixing them.

record.title: Cold Start Latency Study for Serverless Functions
record.description: Measures cold and warm start times for functions across runtimes, memory sizes and package sizes, and publishes guidance on what actually changes startup latency.

record.title: Terraform Module Test Harness
record.description: Tests infrastructure modules by creating them in a temporary account, asserting on what was created and always destroying it afterwards, with cost limits on every run.

record.title: Git Hooks Toolkit for Commit Quality
record.description: Provides pre-commit hooks that check message format, run fast tests and block large files, with a shared configuration that new contributors install in one command.

record.title: AR Shelf Wayfinder for Library Books
record.description: Guides a visitor to a book's shelf with on-screen arrows anchored to the building and highlights the exact shelf level once they arrive, using the catalogue's location data.

record.title: AR Solar System Scale Explorer
record.description: Places the planets in a room at a true relative scale that learners can walk through, with sizes and distances switchable so the vast emptiness of space becomes visible.

record.title: Real-Time Occlusion Demo for AR Objects
record.description: Makes virtual objects appear behind real furniture using depth sensing, and compares how convincing the effect is with and without depth-based occlusion.

record.title: VR Reaction Time and Attention Test Bench
record.description: Measures how quickly a user responds to stimuli in different parts of the visual field in VR, logging results per session so changes over time can be compared.

record.title: VR Comfort Settings Study for Locomotion
record.description: Implements teleport, smooth movement and vignette options in one scene and collects short comfort ratings so designers can see which choices suit which users.

record.title: VR Language Practice Market Scene
record.description: Places learners in a simulated market where they must buy items by speaking the target language, with speech recognition and instant feedback on pronunciation targets.

record.title: Hand-Tracking Piano Practice in AR
record.description: Shows falling note guides on a real keyboard through the headset and uses hand tracking to check which keys were pressed, scoring timing accuracy per phrase.

record.title: Virtual Gallery with Procedural Layout
record.description: Generates an exhibition space automatically from a list of artworks, balancing walking routes, viewing distance and lighting, and lets a curator adjust the result.

record.title: AR Product Colour and Finish Visualiser
record.description: Lets shoppers preview paint colours or materials on real walls and objects with lighting-aware rendering, and compares appearance under different room lighting.

record.title: VR Cognitive Load Dashboard for Training Scenarios
record.description: Collects head movement, gaze and task timing during a VR training run and summarises where trainees hesitated, supporting debrief discussion rather than automated judgement.

record.title: AR Origami Folding Guide
record.description: Overlays the next fold on a paper model step by step with animated arrows, advancing automatically when the fold is detected as complete.

record.title: VR Historical Timeline Walkthrough
record.description: Lets visitors walk along a timeline where each era is a small room with objects and short narration, with events linked to maps and sources.

record.title: AR Cable and Port Labeller for Server Rooms
record.description: Recognises tagged ports and cables and overlays their labels and connection destinations, so technicians can trace a cable without opening spreadsheets.

record.title: Spatial Audio Soundscape Experience
record.description: Builds an environment where sound sources move and reflect in rooms, and tests whether listeners can locate sources correctly with different audio settings.

record.title: Multi-User AR Whiteboard with Shared Anchors
record.description: Lets several people draw on the same virtual surface in a room from their own devices, keeping everyone's view aligned through shared spatial anchors.

record.title: VR Study of Presence and Embodiment with Avatars
record.description: Compares how strongly users feel present when their avatar is a floating hand, full body or abstract shape, using a questionnaire and movement data.

record.title: AR Garden Planner with Sun Path Simulation
record.description: Lets a user place plants in a real garden and shows how sunlight and shade will fall across the day and season, warning when a plant is in the wrong spot.

record.title: VR Circuit Building Lab
record.description: Lets students assemble simple circuits with virtual components and see current and voltage animate, with mistakes such as short circuits explained rather than just failing.

record.title: AR Subtitles for Spoken Conversations
record.description: Displays live captions near the speaker's position in view using direction of arrival from microphone arrays, and evaluates readability in a noisy room.

record.title: VR Virtual Wardrobe Fitting Room
record.description: Fits garment models to an adjustable body shape and shows how fabric drapes and moves, comparing sizes side by side from the user's own measurements.

record.title: Gaze-Controlled Menu System for Hands-Free VR
record.description: Implements menus selected by looking and dwelling, compares dwell times and layouts for speed and error rate, and tests with users who cannot use controllers.

record.title: AR Archaeology Dig Reconstruction Viewer
record.description: Overlays reconstructed walls and artefacts onto a physical model of a dig site, with layers a user can toggle to compare evidence with interpretation.

record.title: Particle Filter Localisation Simulator
record.description: Shows a simulated robot estimating its position on a known map with a particle filter, letting learners change sensor noise and particle count and watch the estimate converge or fail.

record.title: PID Controller Tuning Lab for a Balancing Beam
record.description: Builds a ball-on-beam rig or simulation and lets learners tune proportional, integral and derivative terms, comparing step responses and overshoot for each tuning.

record.title: A-Star Path Planner Comparison with Costmaps
record.description: Plans robot routes over occupancy grids with different heuristics and inflated obstacle costs, and compares path length, safety margin and planning time.

record.title: Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree Planner for a Robot Arm
record.description: Plans collision-free motions for a multi-joint arm in a cluttered workspace with a randomised tree planner, then smooths the path and tests how often it succeeds.

record.title: Kalman Filter Sensor Fusion for a Mobile Robot
record.description: Fuses wheel odometry with an inertial sensor using a Kalman filter and shows how the fused estimate beats either source alone as drift accumulates.

record.title: Ultrasonic Obstacle Mapping with a Servo Scanner
record.description: Sweeps an ultrasonic sensor on a servo to build a simple polar map of obstacles and displays it live, noting how sensor beam width blurs object edges.

record.title: Visual Servoing for Aligning a Gripper to a Target
record.description: Moves an arm so its camera view of a marker matches a target image, using image feedback directly in the control loop instead of a precomputed position.

record.title: Robot Task Planner with Behaviour Trees
record.description: Structures a robot's tasks such as fetch, retry and recover as a behaviour tree, and shows how the tree handles a failed grasp or a blocked corridor.

record.title: Differential Drive Odometry Calibration Tool
record.description: Estimates wheel radius and wheelbase errors by driving test patterns and comparing the robot's belief with measured end positions, then applies the corrections.

record.title: Robot Fleet Charging Scheduler
record.description: Decides when each robot in a small fleet should return to charge so tasks are still finished on time, comparing simple rules with an optimised schedule in simulation.

record.title: Soft Gripper Force Sensing Experiment
record.description: Builds a compliant gripper with flex sensors and measures how grip force relates to sensor readings across objects of different stiffness and shape.

record.title: Occupancy Grid Mapping from Range Sensors
record.description: Builds a map of a simulated room from range readings with probabilistic occupancy updates and compares how sensor noise and robot speed affect map quality.

record.title: Robot Arm Inverse Kinematics Visualiser
record.description: Computes joint angles for a two- and three-link arm to reach a target, shows the multiple solutions and where the arm reaches singular positions.

record.title: Wall-Following Maze Robot with Wheel Encoders
record.description: Navigates a maze by following walls, uses wheel encoders to measure distances and records the walls it has seen to avoid repeating dead ends.

record.title: Human-Aware Navigation with Personal Space Costs
record.description: Adds costs around people in a simulated corridor so the robot passes at a comfortable distance and speed, and evaluates how much extra path length this requires.

record.title: Sim-to-Real Gap Study for a Wheeled Robot
record.description: Trains a controller in simulation, runs it on a physical robot and measures how performance drops, then tests whether adding noise and randomisation during training narrows the gap.

record.title: Servo Smooth Motion Profiler
record.description: Generates trapezoidal and S-curve motion profiles for a servo and compares jerk, vibration and travel time with an abrupt move to the same target.

record.title: Pick and Place Cycle Time Optimiser
record.description: Reorders pick and place sequences and tunes speeds to shorten the cycle time of a small robot arm, checking each change against collision and drop-rate limits.

record.title: Autonomous Rover Energy Budget Planner
record.description: Plans routes for a solar-powered rover by trading distance, slope and sunlight against battery state, and compares plans against a shortest-path baseline.

record.title: Robotic Camera Slider for Time-Lapse Photography
record.description: Moves a camera along a rail at precisely timed steps for time-lapse sequences, with easing curves and a user interface to set duration and distance.

record.title: Multi-Robot Task Allocation by Auction
record.description: Assigns tasks to several simulated robots through bidding rounds and compares the result and communication cost with a central optimiser as tasks and failures increase.

record.title: Robot Safety Zone Monitor with Speed and Separation Limits
record.description: Slows or stops a robot arm when a person enters defined zones, based on distance and relative speed, and tests that the stop happens within a calculated safe distance.
